d:
Yamuna nadi dilli men apni ek khas pahchan rakhti hai. dilli jahan se desh ki rajniti chalti hai, vahan itne salon men yamuna bas rajnitik hichkaule hi khati dikhti hai. uski safaee ke vade kabhi yamuna ke pani tak nahin pahunch pae.
Dekhie yamuna nadi dilli men kahan se pravesh karti hai, vo kis hal men hoti hai aur phir kis tarah shahar se guzarte hue usmen tamam tarah ki gandgi ghulti-milti chali jati hai.
Vidiyoh kalpana
